default.text: You have a strange look, stranger. Lost? The Guild in the west takes in folk like you.

prologue.text: You have a strange look, stranger.

options.text: I fell from the sky. Do you know what that means?

prologue_knew.text: I know what it meant once.

prologue_seen.text: An old man who's seen your kind before.

prologue_through.text: Nobody passes through Hearthmere. They fall into it.

prologue_warn.text: Register at the Guild before sundown, boy. Before they find you again. And leave the girl with Mira. Not with me. Not with anyone the Company knows.
